summary: Relay Therapeutics filed Form 8-K to amend its existing at-the-market (ATM) sales agreement with TD Cowen, increasing capacity from $250 million to $462,978,049, and filing a new prospectus supplement for up to $212,978,049 in additional shares. The filing is routine disclosure of a material agreement amendment for an ATM program, not a special situation. The company sold about $162,978,049 to date. Sales occur at market prices via ordinary brokerage transactions. There is no price per share, premium, or board action. Watch for ongoing dilution from future ATM sales, but no special-situation catalyst or structural change exists.
